extracted.name: Mexican Taco Ring
extracted.description: This Mexican taco ring is made with crescent roll dough wrapped around seasoned ground beef and cheese in a circular shape for a quick, easy meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) package shredded Mexican cheese blend
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir beef and onion in the hot skillet until beef is browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes; drain and discard grease. Add water and taco seasoning to beef mixture; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until water is evaporated, 10 to 15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Remove crescent roll dough from the packaging and separate into individual triangles.

Arrange crescent roll triangles in a circle with the points facing outward on a pizza stone or pan. Spoon ground beef mixture into the center of each dough piece, creating a ring shape. Sprinkle cheese over ground beef mixture. Fold crescent roll points toward the middle, sealing dough together.
Bake in the preheated oven until dough is lightly browned, 11 to 13 minutes.
